mapper.select:
select award, season from ( select 'scoring' as award, ps.SEASON_NUM as season from player_stats ps where ps.PLAYER_ID = #{playerId} and ps.SEASON_NUM < 99 and ps.PLAYER_AVG_SCORE is not null
and ps.PLAYER_AVG_SCORE * LEAST(IFNULL(ps.PLAYER_APPEARANCE, 0), 58) / 58 >= (select max(p2.PLAYER_AVG_SCORE) from player_stats p2 where p2.SEASON_NUM = ps.SEASON_NUM and IFNULL(p2.PLAYER_APPEARANCE, 0) >= 58) union all select 'rebounds', ps.SEASON_NUM from player_stats ps where ps.PLAYER_ID = #{playerId} and ps.SEASON_NUM < 99 and ps.PLAYER_AVG_REB is not null
and ps.PLAYER_AVG_REB * LEAST(IFNULL(ps.PLAYER_APPEARANCE, 0), 58) / 58 >= (select max(p2.PLAYER_AVG_REB) from player_stats p2 where p2.SEASON_NUM = ps.SEASON_NUM and IFNULL(p2.PLAYER_APPEARANCE, 0) >= 58) union all select 'assists', ps.SEASON_NUM from player_stats ps where ps.PLAYER_ID = #{playerId} and ps.SEASON_NUM < 99 and ps.PLAYER_AVG_ASS is not null
and ps.PLAYER_AVG_ASS * LEAST(IFNULL(ps.PLAYER_APPEARANCE, 0), 58) / 58 >= (select max(p2.PLAYER_AVG_ASS) from player_stats p2 where p2.SEASON_NUM = ps.SEASON_NUM and IFNULL(p2.PLAYER_APPEARANCE, 0) >= 58) union all select 'steals', ps.SEASON_NUM from player_stats ps where ps.PLAYER_ID = #{playerId} and ps.SEASON_NUM < 99 and ps.PLAYER_AVG_STEAL is not null
and ps.PLAYER_AVG_STEAL * LEAST(IFNULL(ps.PLAYER_APPEARANCE, 0), 58) / 58 >= (select max(p2.PLAYER_AVG_STEAL) from player_stats p2 where p2.SEASON_NUM = ps.SEASON_NUM and IFNULL(p2.PLAYER_APPEARANCE, 0) >= 58) union all select 'blocks', ps.SEASON_NUM from player_stats ps where ps.PLAYER_ID = #{playerId} and ps.SEASON_NUM < 99 and ps.PLAYER_AVG_BLOCK is not null
and ps.PLAYER_AVG_BLOCK * LEAST(IFNULL(ps.PLAYER_APPEARANCE, 0), 58) / 58 >= (select max(p2.PLAYER_AVG_BLOCK) from player_stats p2 where p2.SEASON_NUM = ps.SEASON_NUM and IFNULL(p2.PLAYER_APPEARANCE, 0) >= 58) ) t order by season

select t.PLAYER_NAME, t.PLAYER_NUMBER, ts.PLAYOFF_RESULT as playoffResult, s.* from player_playoff_stats s left join dream_player t on t.PLAYER_ID = s.PLAYER_ID left join team_season ts on ts.SEASON_NUM = s.SEASON_NUM and ts.TEAM_CODE = SUBSTRING_INDEX(s.PLAYER_TEAM, '->', -1) where s.PLAYER_ID = #{playerId} order by (s.SEASON_NUM = 99), s.SEASON_NUM desc
select AWARD as award, SEASON_NUM as season from season_award where PLAYER_ID = #{playerId} order by SEASON_NUM

select sa.AWARD as award, sa.PLAYER_ID as playerId, dp.PLAYER_NAME as playerName, ps.PLAYER_TEAM as playerTeam, ps.PLAYER_POSITION as playerPosition, ps.PLAYER_AVG_SCORE as pts, ps.PLAYER_AVG_REB as reb, ps.PLAYER_AVG_ASS as ast, pp.PLAYER_AVG_SCORE as poPts, pp.PLAYER_AVG_REB as poReb, pp.PLAYER_AVG_ASS as poAst, pv.PLAYER_AVG_SCORE as prevPts, pv.PLAYER_AVG_REB as prevReb, pv.PLAYER_AVG_ASS as prevAst from season_award sa left join dream_player dp on dp.PLAYER_ID = sa.PLAYER_ID left join player_stats ps on ps.PLAYER_ID = sa.PLAYER_ID and ps.SEASON_NUM = sa.SEASON_NUM left join player_playoff_stats pp on pp.PLAYER_ID = sa.PLAYER_ID and pp.SEASON_NUM = sa.SEASON_NUM left join player_stats pv on pv.PLAYER_ID = sa.PLAYER_ID and pv.SEASON_NUM = sa.SEASON_NUM - 1 where sa.SEASON_NUM = #{seasonNum}

select ts.SEASON_NUM as season, ts.TEAM_CODE as team from team_season ts join player_stats ps on ps.SEASON_NUM = ts.SEASON_NUM and SUBSTRING_INDEX(ps.PLAYER_TEAM, '->', -1) = ts.TEAM_CODE where ps.PLAYER_ID = #{playerId} and ts.PLAYOFF_RESULT = '总冠军' order by ts.SEASON_NUM

select `ROUND` as round, max(OPP_TEAM) as oppTeam, max(PLAYER_APPEARANCE) as games from player_playoff_round_stats where SEASON_NUM = #{seasonNum} and PLAYER_TEAM = #{teamCode} group by `ROUND` order by `ROUND`

select GAME_ID as gameId, GAME_DATE as gameDate, `ROUND` as round, PLAYER_TEAM as playerTeam, OPP_TEAM as oppTeam, HOME as home, WIN as win, TEAM_SCORE as teamScore, OPP_SCORE as oppScore, STARTER as starter, PLAYING_TIME as playingTime, PTS as pts, REB as reb, OFF_REB as offReb, DEF_REB as defReb, AST as ast, STL as stl, BLK as blk, TOV as tov, PF as pf, FGM as fgm, FGA as fga, TPM as tpm, TPA as tpa, FTM as ftm, FTA as fta, PLUS_MINUS as plusMinus from player_game_stats where PLAYER_ID = #{playerId} and SEASON_NUM = #{seasonNum} and SEASON_TYPE = #{seasonType}
order by GAME_DATE desc
mapper.sql: select c.BR_ID as brId, c.PLAYER_ID as playerId, coalesce(p.PLAYER_NAME, c.PLAYER_NAME_ZH, c.PLAYER_NAME) as playerName, c.PLAYER_NAME as nameEn, c.FIRST_YEAR as firstYear, c.LAST_YEAR as lastYear, c.SEASONS as seasons, G as g, rank() over (order by G desc) as gRank, GS as gs, rank() over (order by GS desc) as gsRank, MP as mp, rank() over (order by MP desc) as mpRank, FG as fg, rank() over (order by FG desc) as fgRank, FGA as fga, rank() over (order by FGA desc) as fgaRank, FG3 as fg3, rank() over (order by FG3 desc) as fg3Rank, FG3A as fg3a, rank() over (order by FG3A desc) as fg3aRank, FT as ft, rank() over (order by FT desc) as ftRank, FTA as fta, rank() over (order by FTA desc) as ftaRank, ORB as orb, rank() over (order by ORB desc) as orbRank, DRB as drb, rank() over (order by DRB desc) as drbRank, TRB as trb, rank() over (order by TRB desc) as trbRank, AST as ast, rank() over (order by AST desc) as astRank, STL as stl, rank() over (order by STL desc) as stlRank, BLK as blk, rank() over (order by BLK desc) as blkRank, TOV as tov, rank() over (order by TOV desc) as tovRank, PF as pf, rank() over (order by PF desc) as pfRank, PTS as pts, rank() over (order by PTS desc) as ptsRank, TPL_DBL as tplDbl, rank() over (order by TPL_DBL desc) as tplDblRank , -- 打铁 = 出手 − 命中，跟着一起排名（参考站有这三项） (FGA - FG) as fgMiss, rank() over (order by (FGA - FG) desc) as fgMissRank, (FG3A - FG3) as fg3Miss, rank() over (order by (FG3A - FG3) desc) as fg3MissRank, (FTA - FT) as ftMiss, rank() over (order by (FTA - FT) desc) as ftMissRank from nba_career_totals c left join dream_player p on p.PLAYER_ID = c.PLAYER_ID

choose.when:
select s.SEASON_NUM as seasonNum, s.PLAYER_ID as playerId, coalesce(p.PLAYER_NAME, p.NAME_EN) as playerName, s.PLAYER_TEAM as playerTeam, s.PLAYER_APPEARANCE as games, s.PLAYER_AVG_SCORE as pts, s.PLAYER_AVG_REB as reb, s.PLAYER_AVG_ASS as ast,
s.PLAYER_AVG_BLOCK as blk, s.PLAYER_AVG_STEAL as stl, s.PLAYER_DEF_EFF as defEff from player_stats s left join dream_player p on p.PLAYER_ID = s.PLAYER_ID where s.SEASON_NUM <> 99 and s.MVP_RANK = 1s.DPOY_RANK = 1 order by s.SEASON_NUM desc

select a.SEASON_NUM as seasonNum, a.PLAYER_ID as playerId, coalesce(p.PLAYER_NAME, p.NAME_EN) as playerName, s.PLAYER_TEAM as playerTeam, r.PLAYER_APPEARANCE as games, r.PLAYER_AVG_SCORE as pts, r.PLAYER_AVG_REB as reb, r.PLAYER_AVG_ASS as ast from season_award a left join dream_player p on p.PLAYER_ID = a.PLAYER_ID left join player_stats s on s.PLAYER_ID = a.PLAYER_ID and s.SEASON_NUM = a.SEASON_NUM left join player_playoff_round_stats r on r.PLAYER_ID = a.PLAYER_ID and r.SEASON_NUM = a.SEASON_NUM and r.ROUND = 4 where a.AWARD = 'fmvp' and a.PLAYER_ID is not null order by a.SEASON_NUM desc
choose.otherwise: select a.SEASON_NUM as seasonNum, a.PLAYER_ID as playerId, coalesce(p.PLAYER_NAME, p.NAME_EN) as playerName, s.PLAYER_TEAM as playerTeam, s.PLAYER_APPEARANCE as games, s.PLAYER_AVG_SCORE as pts, s.PLAYER_AVG_REB as reb, s.PLAYER_AVG_ASS as ast from season_award a left join dream_player p on p.PLAYER_ID = a.PLAYER_ID left join player_stats s on s.PLAYER_ID = a.PLAYER_ID and s.SEASON_NUM = a.SEASON_NUM where a.AWARD = #{award} and a.PLAYER_ID is not null order by a.SEASON_NUM desc

mapper.select:
select s.SEASON_NUM as seasonNum, s.PLAYER_ID as playerId, coalesce(p.PLAYER_NAME, p.NAME_EN) as playerName, s.PLAYER_TEAM as playerTeam, s.PLAYER_APPEARANCE as games, ${expr} as val from player_stats s left join dream_player p on p.PLAYER_ID = s.PLAYER_ID join (select SEASON_NUM, ceil(max(PLAYER_APPEARANCE) * 0.7) line, max(PLAYER_APPEARANCE) tg from player_stats where SEASON_NUM <> 99 group by SEASON_NUM) q on q.SEASON_NUM = s.SEASON_NUM join (select s2.SEASON_NUM, max(${expr}) best from player_stats s2 join (select SEASON_NUM, ceil(max(PLAYER_APPEARANCE) * 0.7) line, max(PLAYER_APPEARANCE) tg from player_stats where SEASON_NUM <> 99 group by SEASON_NUM) q2 on q2.SEASON_NUM = s2.SEASON_NUM where s2.SEASON_NUM <> 99 and s2.PLAYER_APPEARANCE >= q2.line and ${expr} is not null
and s2.${madeCol} * s2.PLAYER_APPEARANCE >= #{madeMin} * (q2.tg / 82.0)
group by s2.SEASON_NUM) m on m.SEASON_NUM = s.SEASON_NUM and ${expr} = m.best
join (select SEASON_NUM from player_stats where SEASON_NUM <> 99 group by SEASON_NUM having sum(${expr} is not null) >= 0.5 * count(*)) cov on cov.SEASON_NUM = s.SEASON_NUM where s.SEASON_NUM <> 99 and s.PLAYER_APPEARANCE >= q.line
and s.${madeCol} * s.PLAYER_APPEARANCE >= #{madeMin} * (q.tg / 82.0)
order by s.SEASON_NUM desc

select p.PLAYER_ID as playerId, p.PLAYER_NAME as playerName, p.NAME_EN as nameEn, p.PHOTO as photo, max(c.FIRST_YEAR) as firstYear, max(c.LAST_YEAR) as lastYear from dream_player p left join nba_career_totals c on c.PLAYER_ID = p.PLAYER_ID
where p.PLAYER_NAME like concat('%', #{kw}, '%') or p.NAME_EN like concat('%', #{kw}, '%')
group by p.PLAYER_ID, p.PLAYER_NAME, p.NAME_EN, p.PHOTO
order by (p.PLAYER_NAME = #{kw}) desc, ifnull(max(c.PTS), 0) desc limit #{limit}
